packageRules.description: An x.y.0 release waits 10 days instead of 3 (ADR-0098). The pattern also matches a `v` prefix and a range such as `>=1.2.0`.

agentdev-devcontainer is built by this repository's own pipeline, so its edge digest bumps skip the release-age wait and the daily window (ADR-0098). The pin lives outside the CI image path filter (devcontainer-compose-pins.yml), so merging a bump cannot retrigger the build that produced the digest and bump itself again. Workflow jobs that run in the dev container pin the same digest, and the group moves every reference.

The base image publishes only `edge`, so Renovate moves its digest. A bump edits the image Dockerfile, which rebuilds and accepts the image from the new base before it can merge. That is what makes automerge safe here.

The toolchain mise.toml, mise.dev.toml, and mise.image.toml declare. Renovate's mise manager rewrites each lockfile's checksums with `mise lock` in the same commit, so no bump leaves a pin half-updated. That is what makes batching and automerge safe here. See ADR-0111.
uv is pinned in mise.toml and in the setup-python-venv action input CI runs on. Grouping each keeps its pins in one pull request.

customManagers.description: Versions in the image Dockerfile's `ARG <NAME>_VERSION=` lines and scripts/install-toolchain's `readonly <NAME>_VERSION=` constant, each under a `# renovate:` comment that may name an extractVersion.
npm packages the local pre-commit hooks run through `bunx --package <name>@<version>` or `bunx <name>@<version>`.
